$comment: Packaged app size gate. CI measures every image a PR builds and compares against the latest successful main build (its size-* artifacts) — nothing is committed, so the numbers can't go stale. A PR fails when an image exceeds its budget or grows more than maxGrowthMb vs main. Raising either is allowed — deliberately, in the PR diff. Budgets carry ~10-15% headroom over the measured size: enough for ordinary growth, tight enough that an accidental fat dependency trips before it merges. Local: `npm run dist && npm run size:check` (budgets only; the main baseline lives in CI).
